text:
sam (customer): Hey team — we're seeing streaming responses cut off after ~90s on mobile clients. Client shows partial tokens then a reconnect loop. No 5xx in client logs, just socket closed and then a new connection.

maya (support): Sorry you're hitting this. Can you paste the curl or client snippet you used and any server headers you captured? Is this only mobile?

sam (customer): Repro steps — iOS app using URLSession SSE wrapper. Repro with curl works too (but requires long run). Example:

```
curl -v -N -H "Authorization: Bearer XYZ" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  "https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?model=gpt-edge"\
```

Client output:
```
event: message
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hello wo"}}]}

...socket closed by peer...
(reconnect)
```

No explicit error body. Response headers from first connection: `connection: keep-alive`, `transfer-encoding: chunked`, `server: envoy`, `x-request-id: abc-123`

jordan (eng-runtime): Thanks. Two quick angles: 1) network/proxy idle timeouts (ALB/nginx/envoy) killing long connections; 2) keep-alive strategy. Is the app expecting server-sent keepalive comments? Does the wrapper drop idle connections when it sees no data for N secs?

sam (customer): The wrapper treats silence > 100s as dead and reconnects. We were assuming the SSE would stream tokens frequently but some responses are sparse.

eli (eng-sre): Can you share tcpdump of a failing run? Also want to confirm if connections go through our ALB or a customer mobile carrier NAT. If ALB idle timeout < client timeout you'll see a FIN from proxy.

sam (customer): attaching a short tcpdump excerpt (hex trimmed):
```
14:02:01.000 IP client > lb: P  seq=1 ack=1 win=65535
14:03:32.100 IP lb > client: R  seq=0 ack=0 
```

maya (support): That looks like the load balancer is resetting. Which ALB timeout configured? Jordan?

jordan (eng-runtime): For hosted routes default idle is 60s on our public ALB. We increased some customers to 300s historically. If client silently expects longer than 60s we get resets. We're exploring comment pings vs TCP keepalive. Important differences: 
- TCP keepalive may be suppressed by NATs and mobile carriers.
- SSE comment pings (`: ping

`) are application-level and traverse proxies if not stripped.

sam (customer): Is there a recommended pattern? We can't control carrier NAT.

eli (eng-sre): For mobile we recommend server-side application-level comment pings every 25–30s plus setting ALB idle to > 2x comment interval. Also advise client to tolerate comment-only events. Example comment ping we use:
```
: keepalive

```
SSE semantics: a line starting with `:` is a comment and should be ignored by event parsers but still counts as activity on wire.

jordan (eng-runtime): Caveat: some proxies/gzip layers strip blank lines or compress out single-character frames. Also HTTP/2 with HPACK can coalesce. We had one case where `Transfer-Encoding: chunked` + gzip + envoy health filter rewrote empty chunks and dropped comment-only chunks. If teams use comment pings, include a tiny JSON heartbeat event occasionally:
```
event: heartbeat
data: {"t": 1680000000}

```
This avoids proxies that remove comments.

maya (support): @sam can you test with a patched server that emits both `: keepalive` and `event: heartbeat` every 25s for 10 minutes and report whether the app still reconnects?

sam (customer): Will try. Also saw partial output where tokens stop mid-word — is that our model or the connection?

jordan (eng-runtime): Partial tokens mid-word typically mean the connection closed before the final chunk. We flush tokens as they are generated; if stream is interrupted the client gets prefix. Not a model issue.

sam (customer): Ran the test. With `: keepalive` only — still saw disconnects at ~65s. With `event: heartbeat` every 25s — stable for 15 minutes.

eli (eng-sre): That matches proxy behavior. Action: we should update docs to recommend dual-mode keepalive (comment + heartbeat event) for worst-case NATs/proxies. Also we need a config knob to enable heartbeat events per route. Filing infra task.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: increase default ALB idle timeout to 300s for streaming-prod (rollout window 02:00-04:00 UTC).

maya (support): For billing and support: this customer's usage dropped for 2 hours due to reconnect loops. Need to reconcile tokens billed for partial responses vs retries. @finance add ticket?

jordan (eng-runtime): Also adding instrumentation: emit `streaming.keepalive.sent` metric and `streaming.disconnect.reason` tag (idle-timeout|client-reset|error). That will help diagnose similar reports.

sam (customer): Thanks all — heartbeat event fixed my mobile repro. Will monitor and report back if anything else. Appreciate the fast triage. :thumbsup:

eli (eng-sre): Follow-ups:
- Docs update: recommended keepalive snippet, ALB settings, and client reconnection backoff.
- Infra: config toggle for heartbeat events + rollout.
- Observability: new metrics and dashboard.

maya (support): Closing once rollout completes and customer confirms.

sam (customer): Confirmed after 24h: no reconnections. Billing impact minimal.
